اعتزمتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمْتُمَا (iʕtazamtumā) /iʕ.ta.zam.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمْتُمَا (uʕtuzimtumā) /uʕ.tu.zim.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
